tables.about: Joiners as ranges of scalars [first, last], measured on the Mac that wrote this file: address_marks, the units of the BMP after which a word's "://", "?" or "#" does not count; boundary_skips, the scalars that a shape's \b looks past. Each port holds these lists, not its own Unicode data.
